annotations.summary: NAMRBD SBS service is not ready
annotations.description: The SBS control service readiness probe has reported not-ready for at least two minutes.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD SBS service leader is missing
annotations.description: No SBS service endpoint is currently reporting leadership.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD SBS data service is not ready
annotations.description: An SBS data endpoint readiness probe has reported not-ready for at least two minutes.
A NAMRBD gateway HTTP control endpoint has reported not-ready for at least two minutes.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD iSCSI gateway is not ready
annotations.description: A NAMRBD iSCSI gateway observability endpoint has reported not-ready for at least two minutes.
At least one SBS node has been classified as down by the service control plane.
At least one replicated volume has lost full health according to SBS placement state.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD SBS repair backlog is active
annotations.description: SBS has active repair placement work for at least fifteen minutes.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD SBS repair backlog is stale
annotations.description: The oldest failed repair or rebalance batch has been waiting longer than thirty minutes.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD SBS repair or rebalance failures exist
annotations.description: SBS repair or rebalance child batches have failed and are awaiting retry or operator review.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD SBS rebalance backlog is active
annotations.description: SBS has active rebalance placement work for at least thirty minutes.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD SBS node probes are failing
annotations.description: At least one SBS node has a non-zero reconciler probe failure streak.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD retired payload backlog is active
annotations.description: Retired payload cleanup has pending chunks for at least thirty minutes.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD SBS maintenance transition failures exist
annotations.description: SBS maintenance has recorded failed transition batches that require operator review.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD retired payload cleanup failures exist
annotations.description: Retired payload garbage collection has failed batches that may delay space reclamation.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD SBS placement apply failures are occurring
annotations.description: The internal placement apply RPC path has reported non-ok outcomes in the last ten minutes.

annotations.summary: NAMRBD SBS data store has low available capacity ratio
annotations.description: An SBS data store has less than ten percent available capacity. Tune this ratio for your deployment.
